opening.argument: The speaker presents a concrete paid route into StrongBlock-related nodes: one STRONGER token buys a node with node-related benefits. He reinforces that invitation by declaring himself “very bullish on the whole strong roadmap” and promoting free STRONG nodes through linked social destinations. The displayed trading-listing post also supplies “Trade” and “Details” links, encouraging viewers to participate. Together, the token payment, favorable endorsement and linked node promotions establish a scam pitch centered on paid node benefits. The claim rests on that promotion; it does not require proof of viewer losses or completed purchases.
